artifacts.summary: Execution summary for the lit-coverage resolution-failure-signal fix: instrumented skip path, extended marker schema, documented threshold policy, added Section G regression test, verified both marker consumers unchanged.

completion_data.completion_summary: Instrumented literature-briefing.sh's repo-mode skip site with a counter/array, ended the silent full-failure exit, extended the lit-coverage marker with requested=/resolved=/skipped=/skip_rate= folded into the existing sparse boolean via a new skip-rate threshold, surfaced skipped doc_ids in the briefing body, documented the policy in sparse-coverage.md, and added a Section G regression test (4 assertion groups, confirmed to fail on revert) to test-lit-pipeline.sh -- full runtime suite passes 30/30 and both existing marker consumers verified unmodified and functioning.

memory_candidates.content: When adding new fields to a greppable machine-readable marker line that existing consumers pattern-match with a `.*`-tolerant grep, append new fields strictly after all pre-existing fields (never interleave) and verify byte-for-byte prefix stability empirically by diffing marker output from the pre-change script against the post-change script on identical fixtures -- don't just reason about it, actually capture both and diff.

When a regression test asserts a fix closes a defect, confirm the test actually detects the defect (not just that it passes) by temporarily reverting the fix, re-running the test, confirming it fails, then restoring the fix and re-verifying a clean run. A test that passes vacuously (never having failed against the pre-fix code) provides no real regression protection.

literature-search.sh's do_search() quarantines any doc_id whose provenance_fidelity (looked up from $LITERATURE_DIR/index.json) is missing or one of unverified_summary/unverified_no_baseline/unadjudicated -- fail-open means an absent index.json entry is treated as unverified and excluded from default search results. A hand-built global-mode test fixture for literature-briefing.sh --global must include an index.json entry with provenance_fidelity: verified_conversion for the doc_id backing its chunks_data rows, or the search silently returns zero results.
